meta.title: Which page the pad shows (as built, 2026-10-27)
meta.subtitle: The owner's seven profiles under spec 6.1 and 6.3 and keyvo_core::state: Global (context, general, apps), VS Code and Brave (context, general), Konsole, Dolphin, Mailspring and Discord (context only). Short press: a page button released within 1 s. Long press: held 1 s. page_grace 10 s.

waiting.label: Page reachable in manual mode only

transitions.label: short press, or app switch after 10 s

cards.title: Auto mode: two pages per app at most
items: The focused window chooses the profile; the pad shows that profile's context page.
A short press of either button on any context page shows the global general page; the next short press returns to the focused window's context page.
An app's own page 2 is never shown in auto mode, whatever it is named: this is the VS Code finding of 2026-10-27.

cards.title: Manual mode: a focus lock with paging
items: Solid red transitions need manual mode (a long press first); dashed ones are the escape with both buttons held.
A long press (1 s) toggles the mode and keeps the profile and page on the pad; focus changes are recorded but not shown.
Right pages forward, left back, wrapping within the shown profile: Global has three pages, VS Code and Brave two, the others one.
Leaving manual mode shows the context page of the window focused meanwhile.
Brave has the same shape as VS Code (context and a page 2 named general) and is drawn as the VS Code states.

cards.title: Grace, hold and escape
items: On the general page an app switch within 10 s (page_grace) of a press keeps the general page; a title change in the same app keeps it too.
The keyvo app's own window holds the context: focusing it changes nothing on the pad.
Both buttons held together escape from any state to Global, context, auto mode (drawn once, from VS Code page 2).

cards.title: What is on each page (the owner's profiles)
items: Global context: Region, Konsole, Git, Paperclip, keyvo PRs, Horde, Play, Mute, Lock. Global general: YouTube, HASS, Dockge, Stagely, Claude, Codecov, GH status, Plex, Remote. Global apps: Mail, Discord, Signal, Obsidian, Spotify, KCalc, Downloads, Displays, Full shot.
VS Code context: Palette, Terminal, Find all, Git, Go to file, Sidebar, Format, Save all, Zen. VS Code page 2: Split, Close, Problem, Rename, Definition, Back, Comment, Quick fix, Konsole.
Brave context: New tab, Reopen, Find, Claude, GitHub, Paperclip, Stagely, HASS, Dockge. Brave page 2: YouTube, Claude, Codecov, GH status, Plex, Devtools, Reload, History, Downloads.
Konsole, Dolphin, Mailspring and Discord have a context page only; a key they lack comes from the global context page (the stack).
